findings.finding: The cases say to search the exact handler name in Tools > Catalog, but the catalog defaults to Agent surface. These eight names are internal delegates, so the search returns no matching row under the default filter. Add a step to select Internal delegates or All handlers before searching; submit_form is on Agent surface.

The no-match negative follows a successful selection of B. The handler returns before calling target.click(), so B remains selected and the change count remains unchanged. Expected text currently says A remains selected; change that to B.

The no-form negative has no exact JSON, unlike the other cases. Specify {"selector":"#missing-form"} against an owned fixture with no matching element, then assert No form found and unchanged submit count.

The page is described by control IDs, initial states, and event oracles, but no named owned HTTP fixture or exact markup is supplied. The precondition correctly stops browser execution until a fixture URL/hash and controlled event observables exist. These are design procedures, not currently runnable evidence.
